title: finding(plugin-charts): `yAxis[].position` is kept but not honoured — a lone `position: 'right'` entry draws on the left, `top` / `bottom` pass silently, and a second entry is always the right axis (y twin of objectui#10587)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites (class a). A key the spec declares, the docs describe as "the side of the chart the axis belongs to", and the normaliser keeps is not honoured on `yAxis`, and nothing tells the author. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`). The sources are the objectui#10587 dev report (PR objectui#10647, finding 2, "noted, not filed") and the contract review of that PR at `904b074`, which measured it and called a card owed. It is the y-side twin of objectui#10587, same class and a separate key. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Sites (the reviewer's reading at PR objectui#10647's head `904b074`, which does not change the y-axis path; ⛔ not re-read by the seat)

- `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`:
  - `hasDualAxis` is `yAxes.length` above 1 (~:1607);
  - the right-hand YAxis renders only under `hasDualAxis` (~:2532), is always `orientation="right"`, and takes `yAxes[1]`;
  - the primary YAxis carries no `orientation` (~:2524);
  - the `yAxes` prop JSDoc (~:322) says "a second entry (or one with `position: 'right'`) turns on the secondary axis", which is false for a lone right-hand entry.
- `packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts:526` binds a `position: 'right'` FIRST entry's series to the right axis. The normaliser keeps only the four enum values (~:323-326).
- Spec: `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 declares `position: z.enum(['left','right','top','bottom']).optional()`, shared by both axes.

## Measurement (the PR objectui#10647 reviewer's probe through the real render path; ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

- A bar chart with a lone `yAxis: [{ field: 'revenue', position: 'right' }]` draws its only value axis on the LEFT. Every value tick is `orientation="left"`, 0 notes, and the bars are drawn.
- `position: 'top'` on a y entry draws left, in silence.
- `[{ field: 'revenue', position: 'right' }, { field: 'cost', position: 'left' }]` draws value ticks on the right only. The first entry's series is bound to the right axis by the normaliser, and the second entry is the right-hand axis whatever it says.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Follow objectui#10587's shape, as PR objectui#10647 lands it for `xAxis.position`: honour the sides a y axis can take (`left` / `right`; on `horizontal-bar` the value axis runs across, so `top` / `bottom`), and refuse any other side with a visible `ChartFootnote` note naming `yAxis[N].position`, never in silence. Settle which entry is the primary axis when both entries name a side. Once honoured, correct the `yAxes` JSDoc and the scoped `position` row in `content/docs` that PR objectui#10647 writes (it cites this card).

## Dedupe

REST read of every objectui issue and PR updated since 2026-09-25T00:00Z (367 items), with titles matched against `yAxis|y-axis|y axis|horizontal-bar|axis title|right-hand|position`: the only hits are objectui#10587 (x side) and its PR objectui#10647, plus objectui#10516, objectui#10518, objectui#10601, objectui#10511 and objectui#10608 (declaration and normaliser work, none about the rendered side). The regex walk over the 1000 most recently updated items, `yAxis.*position|position.*yAxis|right-hand.*axis|secondary axis`, gives 5 hits, none about this defect.

Dedupe words: `yAxis position right drawn left` · `lone right-hand y axis` · `hasDualAxis second entry right` · `yAxis position silent`
